scripts.test:app: cd app && npm run build:app && npm run test
scripts.build:local: npm run build:app_local && npm run build:api_local
scripts.init: npm install && npm run init:app && npm run build:local
scripts.ci: npm install && npm run ci:submodules && npm run ci:app && npm run ci:api && npm run ci:maintenance
scripts.ci:maintenance: cd maintenance && npm ci && npm test
scripts.format: npm run format:local && (cd submodules/mapx-style && node ../../node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write "**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}") && (cd submodules/zartigl && node ../../node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write "**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}")
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:local && (cd submodules/mapx-style && node ../../node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check "**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}") && (cd submodules/zartigl && node ../../node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check "**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}")
scripts.lint: npm run lint:local && (cd submodules/mapx-style && node ../../node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js . --max-warnings 0) && (cd submodules/zartigl && node ../../node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js . --max-warnings 0)
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:local && (cd submodules/mapx-style && node ../../node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js . --fix --max-warnings 0) && (cd submodules/zartigl && node ../../node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js . --fix --max-warnings 0)
scripts.quality: npm run quality:policy && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:quality
